caption: The drawing depicts a detailed image of a brown leather saddle with various intricate parts. It features a prominent pommel at the top, and the saddle is shown with attached stirrups and multiple straps hanging down. The seat and side flaps display decorative blue and white embroidered or painted patterns. There is a blanket or pad beneath the saddle, which has a worn, patchwork appearance in shades of beige, tan, and off-white. The saddle is rendered in natural earthy tones, including browns, tans, and creams, and the drawing is positioned centrally against a plain, light beige or off-white background. The names "A 884" and "Lyman Young" are written in small letters near the saddle.
title: Woman's Side Saddle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
